```{r}
# MLE simulation
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(321)

p_true  <- 0.3
q_true  <- 0.2
pi_true <- 0.8

n      <- 25                
N_vals <- c(50, 100, 300)    
M      <- 500               

simulate_batch <- function(N) {
  p_est  <- numeric(M)
  q_est  <- numeric(M)
  pi_est <- numeric(M)
  
  for(m in seq_len(M)) {
    N_AA <- N_AB <- N_BA <- N_BB <- 0
    N0_A <- 0
    
    for(i in seq_len(N)) {
      
      s <- integer(n)
      s[1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < pi_true, 1, 2)  
      if(s[1] == 1) N0_A <- N0_A + 1
      
      for(t in seq_len(n-1)) {
        if(s[t] == 1) {
          s[t+1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < p_true, 2, 1)
          if(s[t+1] == 1) N_AA <- N_AA + 1 else N_AB <- N_AB + 1
        } else {
          s[t+1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < q_true, 1, 2)
          if(s[t+1] == 1) N_BA <- N_BA + 1 else N_BB <- N_BB + 1
        }
      }
    }
    
    p_est[m]  <- N_AB / (N_AA + N_AB)
    q_est[m]  <- N_BA / (N_BA + N_BB)
    pi_est[m] <- N0_A / N
  }
  
  data.frame(
    N     = N,
    p_hat = p_est,
    q_hat = q_est,
    pi_hat = pi_est
  )
}

results <- bind_rows(lapply(N_vals, simulate_batch))

sd_summary <- results %>%
  group_by(N) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_p  = sd(p_hat),
    sd_q  = sd(q_hat),
    sd_pi = sd(pi_hat)
  )
print(sd_summary)

ci_summary <- results %>%
  group_by(N) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_p  = mean(p_hat),
    sd_p    = sd(p_hat),
    lower_p = mean_p - 1.96 * sd_p,
    upper_p = mean_p + 1.96 * sd_p,
    mean_q  = mean(q_hat),
    sd_q    = sd(q_hat),
    lower_q = mean_q - 1.96 * sd_q,
    upper_q = mean_q + 1.96 * sd_q,
    mean_pi  = mean(pi_hat),
    sd_pi    = sd(pi_hat),
    lower_pi = mean_pi - 1.96 * sd_pi,
    upper_pi = mean_pi + 1.96 * sd_pi
  )

```



```{r}
# Plots
library(grid) 
library(ggpubr)
library(grid)   

p_p <- ggplot(results, aes(x = p_hat, color = factor(N), fill = factor(N))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = p_true, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = lower_p, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = upper_p, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Sampling distribution of " * hat(p)),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",
    fill  = "# Traces"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",                     
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt")
  )

p_q <- ggplot(results, aes(x = q_hat, color = factor(N), fill = factor(N))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q_true, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = lower_q, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = upper_q, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Sampling distribution of " * hat(q)),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",
    fill  = "# Traces"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",                    
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15, unit = "pt")
  )

p_pi <- ggplot(results, aes(x = pi_hat, color = factor(N), fill = factor(N))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pi_true, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = lower_pi, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = ci_summary,
    aes(xintercept = upper_pi, color = factor(N)),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Sampling distribution of " * hat(pi)[A]),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",
    fill  = "# Traces"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "right",                    
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size   = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin       = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 15, unit = "pt")
  )

combined_plot <- ggarrange(
  p_p, p_q, p_pi,
  ncol          = 3,
  nrow          = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend        = "right"
)

# (3) Print the combined plot
print(combined_plot)
```



```{r}
# Bayesian part
p_true  <- 0.3
q_true  <- 0.2
pi_true <- 0.8

alpha_pi <- 2; beta_pi <- 2
alpha_p  <- 2; beta_p  <- 2
alpha_q  <- 2; beta_q  <- 2

n      <- 25
N_vals <- c(500, 1000, 3000)

posterior_list <- lapply(N_vals, function(N) {
  N_AA <- N_AB <- N_BA <- N_BB <- 0
  N0_A <- 0

  for(i in 1:N) {
    s <- integer(n)
    s[1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < pi_true, 1, 2)
    if(s[1] == 1) N0_A <- N0_A + 1

    for(t in 1:(n-1)) {
      if(s[t] == 1) {
        s[t+1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < p_true, 2, 1)
        if(s[t+1] == 1) N_AA <- N_AA + 1 else N_AB <- N_AB + 1
      } else {
        s[t+1] <- ifelse(runif(1) < q_true, 1, 2)
        if(s[t+1] == 1) N_BA <- N_BA + 1 else N_BB <- N_BB + 1
      }
    }
  }

  alpha_pi_post <- alpha_pi + N0_A
  beta_pi_post  <- beta_pi  + (N - N0_A)
  alpha_p_post  <- alpha_p  + N_AB
  beta_p_post   <- beta_p   + N_AA
  alpha_q_post  <- alpha_q  + N_BA
  beta_q_post   <- beta_q   + N_BB

  ci_pi <- qbeta(c(0.025, 0.975), alpha_pi_post, beta_pi_post)
  ci_p  <- qbeta(c(0.025, 0.975), alpha_p_post,  beta_p_post)
  ci_q  <- qbeta(c(0.025, 0.975), alpha_q_post,  beta_q_post)

  list(
    N = N,
    post_params = data.frame(
      param = c("pi_A", "p", "q"),
      alpha = c(alpha_pi_post, alpha_p_post,  alpha_q_post),
      beta  = c(beta_pi_post,  beta_p_post,   beta_q_post),
      ci_lo = c(ci_pi[1],      ci_p[1],       ci_q[1]),
      ci_hi = c(ci_pi[2],      ci_p[2],       ci_q[2]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
})


ci_data <- bind_rows(lapply(posterior_list, function(entry) {
  df <- entry$post_params[, c("param", "ci_lo", "ci_hi")]
  df$N <- factor(entry$N)
  df
}), .id = "dummy") %>%
  select(N, param, ci_lo, ci_hi)

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 2000)

all_post_df <- bind_rows(lapply(posterior_list, function(entry) {
  df <- entry$post_params
  df$N <- factor(entry$N)
  df
}), .id = "dummy") %>%
  select(N, param, alpha, beta)

plot_exact <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(all_post_df), function(i) {
  this_row <- all_post_df[i, ]
  a <- this_row$alpha
  b <- this_row$beta
  data.frame(
    N       = this_row$N,
    param   = this_row$param,
    x       = x_grid,
    density = dbeta(x_grid, a, b),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

data_pi <- subset(plot_exact, param == "pi_A")
data_p  <- subset(plot_exact, param == "p")
data_q  <- subset(plot_exact, param == "q")

cis_pi  <- subset(ci_data, param == "pi_A")
lo_pi   <- min(cis_pi$ci_lo);   hi_pi <- max(cis_pi$ci_hi)
rng_pi  <- hi_pi - lo_pi
mgn_pi  <- 0.10 * rng_pi
xlo_pi  <- max(0, lo_pi - mgn_pi)
xhi_pi  <- min(1, hi_pi + mgn_pi)

cis_p   <- subset(ci_data, param == "p")
lo_p    <- min(cis_p$ci_lo);    hi_p  <- max(cis_p$ci_hi)
rng_p   <- hi_p - lo_p
mgn_p   <- 0.10 * rng_p
xlo_p   <- max(0, lo_p - mgn_p)
xhi_p   <- min(1, hi_p + mgn_p)

cis_q   <- subset(ci_data, param == "q")
lo_q    <- min(cis_q$ci_lo);    hi_q  <- max(cis_q$ci_hi)
rng_q   <- hi_q - lo_q
mgn_q   <- 0.10 * rng_q
xlo_q   <- max(0, lo_q - mgn_q)
xhi_q   <- min(1, hi_q + mgn_q)


plot_pi_exact <- ggplot(data_pi, aes(x = x, y = density, fill = N)) +
  geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.2) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = N), size = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = pi_true, 
    linetype   = "dashed", 
    color      = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "pi_A"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_lo, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "pi_A"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_hi, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Posterior of " * pi[A]),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",    
    fill  = "# Traces"    
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xlo_pi, xhi_pi)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none", 
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin      = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt")
  )

plot_p_exact <- ggplot(data_p, aes(x = x, y = density, fill = N)) +
  geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = N), size = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = p_true, 
    linetype   = "dashed", 
    color      = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "p"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_lo, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "p"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_hi, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Posterior of " * p),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",
    fill  = "# Traces"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xlo_p, xhi_p)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin      = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15, unit = "pt")
  )

plot_q_exact <- ggplot(data_q, aes(x = x, y = density, fill = N)) +
  geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = N), size = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = q_true,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "q"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_lo, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = subset(ci_data, param == "q"),
    aes(xintercept = ci_hi, color = N),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Posterior of " * q),
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    color = "# Traces",
    fill  = "# Traces"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xlo_q, xhi_q)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size   = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin       = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 15, unit = "pt")
  )


combined_exact <- ggarrange(
  plot_p_exact, plot_q_exact, plot_pi_exact,
  ncol          = 3,
  nrow          = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend        = "right"
)


print(combined_exact)
```
